caption:
Nine templates. Three are free.
TeXline, Stack First and Campus One are free. Nova, Product Engineer, Systems Lead, ATS Dense, Staff+ Impact and Executive Mono are Pro. Nova has a one-column or two-column switch.
Export to PDF or plain text — free, unlimited and watermark-free on the free plan. Word export is Pro.
Six layout rules are measured on the rendered page after every edit. Not a certification against any ATS vendor.
